purpose: check discovery/diff/<area>.json (J6) and the J7 files (asset index, registry in step, refs, sheets, db tables, loc keys), render discovery/{diff,assets,db,loc}/README.md, and run the J7 passes
usage: python3 core/wsc.py discovery check | render | assets | sheets | db | loc | all   (assets, sheets, db, loc and all read the install on the PC; all = assets, db, loc, sheets, then render)
when: after any discovery pass (discovery/core/*.py) rewrites a result; `check` also fails when a committed README is stale (tests/test_discovery.py runs it in the tests gate)

purpose: parse the vanilla key table (data.pack text\\default_keys.xml, or a custom_keys.keys.xml) into `vanilla.<keyset>.<func>.<n>` hotkeys rows through the registry, and check every row for clashes (same binding in a clashing context, a bare key that fires with any modifier, an OS combo)
usage: python3 core/wsc.py hotkeys import (--from-pack [<data dir>] | <keys.xml>) [--keyset fps] [--no-loc] [--dry-run]  |  python3 core/wsc.py hotkeys check
when: after a game update (reseed: `hotkeys import --from-pack`, then `reg render hotkeys` and review the diff of registries/hotkeys.jsonl); before adding any mod hotkey (`hotkeys check` is also run by tests/test_hotkeys.py in the `tests` gate)

purpose: Check the jobs registry against jobs/ (status invariants, file links, brief shape), pick the next job to build or review, and show the queue as a readable page.
usage: python3 core/wsc.py jobs check | jobs next [--id J<n>] [--offline] | jobs review [--id J<n>] [--offline] | jobs view [--offline] [--out PATH] [--no-open] | jobs view --serve [--port N] [--dry-run] [--no-open]
when: `next` when Liam says "pick up the next job" (`--id` for a named job: what a session launched from the view runs); `review` for "review the next job"; `check` runs in the tests gate (CI) and before pushing a brief or a job row change; `view` to read the queue in a browser instead of registries/jobs.md, `view --serve` to start a job's brief, build or review session from its button.

purpose: check Git Bash, python3 >= 3.12, the core submodule at the pinned tag, core.hooksPath, LF shell scripts, gh auth, Docker Desktop, the empire-remastered sibling clone, Python Playwright with Chromium, the PC watcher and the PC rules (exe vanilla, no .git in or above a game folder, nothing foreign in the Napoleon folder: J18); `--fix` applies the safe fixes (a python3.exe copy, core.hooksPath)
usage: python3 core/wsc.py setup [--fix] [--skip <check>...]
when: once per clone or PC, after a reboot or tool update, and whenever a gate or the watcher route fails for an environment reason
